name: Zap Attack!
review:
Zap Attack! is a 5x5, 25-line alien slot with expanding multiplier wilds up to x5. The bonus upgrades symbols into high-pays.

Thunderkick rates it High volatility, with a 5,000x cap and a 96.15% RTP.

Expanding multiplier wilds up to x5 can cover whole reels, and the alien bonus upgrades symbols into premiums. Light, colourful sci-fi fun.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
